title: 第四週總複習＋階段模考

sections.title: TOEIC 金色證書 90 天訓練｜Day 28
sections.markdown:
## 第四週總複習＋階段模考

今天不急著塞大量新文法，而是檢查 Day 22～27 能不能真正整合使用。核心能力是：

> **Grammar：結構判斷速度**  
> **Listening：聽條件 → 找圖表 → 推論意圖／下一步**  
> **Reading：Timeline → Update → Exception → Cross-reference**

因目前沒有收到 Day 27 的實際作答成績，今天採 **860～900+ 混合難度**。今天的階段模考結果會決定第五週應該維持目前難度，還是正式進入 900+ 高密度模式。

建議時間：**約 100 分鐘**。

---

sections.title: ① 今日單字｜第四週核心 30 字

sections.title: ② Grammar Review｜第一關：that / what / whether
sections.markdown:
### 1

We confirmed _____ the payment had been received.

(A) what  
(B) that  
(C) whether  
(D) whom

答案：

**B**

因為：

> the payment had been received

完整句。

---

### 2

We don't know _____ caused the delay.

(A) that  
(B) what  
(C) whether  
(D) when

答案：

**B**

`what` 本身當：

> caused 的主詞

---

### 3

We need to determine _____ the supplier can meet the deadline.

(A) that  
(B) what  
(C) whether  
(D) whose

答案：

**C**

= 是否。

---

sections.title: ③ Grammar Review｜第二關：V-ing / V-ed
sections.markdown:
不要背：

> 人 = ed  
> 物 = ing

真正判斷：

> **主動 → V-ing**

> **被動 → V-ed**

例如：

> employees _____ in Taipei

employees 主動 work：

**working**

> products _____ in Taiwan

products 被 manufacture：

**manufactured**

> documents _____ yesterday

documents 被 submit：

**submitted**

---

sections.title: ④ Grammar Review｜第三關：比較級
sections.markdown:
快速回收：

> much **better**

> significantly **higher**

> far **more efficient**

> not **as expensive as**

> one of **the most successful campaigns**

兩個：

> **better**

三個以上：

> **the best**

---

sections.title: ⑤ Grammar Review｜第四關：although / despite
sections.markdown:
核心只看空格後。

> _____ the weather was poor

後面 S + V：

**Although**

> _____ the poor weather

後面名詞：

**Despite**

> _____ working remotely

後面 V-ing：

**Despite**

---

sections.title: ⑥ Grammar Review｜第五關：Condition
sections.markdown:
第四週最重要的五個：

| Expression | 核心 |
|---|---|
| unless | if not |
| provided that | 前提是 |
| once | 一旦 |
| as soon as | 一……就立即 |
| in case | 預防可能發生 |

比較：

> Call me **if** there is a problem.

問題發生 → 打電話。

> Keep my number **in case** there is a problem.

現在先留電話 → 預防未來可能有問題。

---

sections.title: ⑦ Grammar 900+ 陷阱
sections.markdown:
> We will begin production as soon as the equipment _____.

(A) will arrive  
(B) arrives  
(C) arriving  
(D) will have arrived

答案：

**B**

即使是在談未來：

> as soon as + **現在式**

主句：

> **will begin**

所以：

> We **will begin** production as soon as the equipment **arrives**.

---

sections.markdown:
### Conference Rooms

| Room | Capacity | Video | Availability |

sections.title: ⑨ Listening 階段模考｜Set 2
sections.markdown:
### Q4

Why is the speaker calling?

(A) To report a delivery problem  
(B) To cancel an order  
(C) To apply for a position  
(D) To request payment

### Q5

Why does the speaker say, “That shouldn't cause any problems”?

(A) The customer canceled the order  
(B) The new delivery date still meets the customer's deadline  
(C) The replacement product is cheaper  
(D) The warehouse has reopened

### Q6

What will most likely happen next?

(A) The order will be refunded  
(B) The customer will receive an updated confirmation  
(C) Another supplier will be selected  
(D) The products will be returned

聽力稿：

> Hello, Mr. Lin. I'm calling about order 7185. Because of a transportation delay, your shipment will arrive Thursday instead of Wednesday. I see in your order notes that you don't need the equipment until Friday, so that shouldn't cause any problems. I'll send you an updated delivery confirmation by e-mail this afternoon.

答案：

**4A / 5B / 6B**

900 分能力：

> Wednesday → Thursday

不能只看到：

> delayed

就認為一定造成問題。

還要結合：

> customer needs Friday

因此：

> Thursday ≤ Friday

→ 沒問題。

---

### Shipping

|---|---|---:|
| Economy | Monday | $7 |

| Express | Thursday | $20 |

### Q7

What does the speaker need to send?

(A) Product samples  
(B) A signed agreement

### Q8

What requirement is mentioned?

(A) Delivery by Friday

(C) Fee below $10  
(D) Overnight delivery

### Q9

Which service should be used?

(A) Economy  
(B) Standard  
(C) Express  
(D) Priority

> We finally received the client's signature on the agreement, so please send the original document today. They need it no later than Friday. There's no need to pay extra for earlier delivery, so choose the least expensive option that will get it there on time.

> Friday or earlier

有：

Standard / Express / Priority

但是：

> cheapest

→ **Standard**

sections.title: ⑪ Listening 今日能力檢查
sections.markdown:
如果你 Q2 或 Q9 錯，不一定是 Listening 不好。

可能是：

> **I — Information Integration**

如果 Q5 錯：

可能是：

> **T — Timeline**

因為：

> Thu delivery  
> Friday need

如果 Q6 錯：

可能是：

> **N — Next Action**

今天新增這個錯題標籤：

> **N = Next Action / 下一步推論**

sections.title: ⑫ Reading 階段模考｜Double Passage
sections.markdown:
限時：

**5 分鐘。**

### Passage 1 — Original Reservation Policy

> **Brighton Business Center**
>
> Meeting rooms may be canceled without charge at least 48 hours before the scheduled reservation.
>
> Cancellations received less than 48 hours before a reservation are normally subject to a fee equal to 50 percent of the room charge.
>
> Customers may change the reservation time without a fee provided that another room is available on the same day.
>
> Catering orders must normally be changed or canceled at least 72 hours in advance.
>
> Once a catering order enters preparation, its cost cannot normally be refunded.

### Passage 2 — Message

> **To:** Event Services  
> **From:** Anna Huang  
> **Subject:** Friday Training Session
>
> I'm writing about our training session scheduled for Friday at 1 P.M.
>
> Because several employees now have an unexpected client meeting that afternoon, we'd like to move the training session to Friday morning if possible.
>
> I called your office this morning, and your representative mentioned that Room 3 is available from 9 A.M. to noon.
>
> We also ordered lunch for 18 participants. Since we would finish before noon if the meeting is moved, we would like to cancel the catering order.
>
> Our reservation is approximately 36 hours from now. Please let me know what changes can still be made.

### Q1

When can a room normally be canceled without charge?

(A) 24 hours in advance  
(B) 36 hours in advance  
(C) 48 hours in advance  
(D) 72 hours in advance

### Q2

What does Anna want to change?

(A) The meeting date  
(B) The meeting time  
(C) The number of employees  
(D) The venue

### Q3

Why does Anna mention Room 3?

(A) It is larger  
(B) It is available Friday morning  
(C) Catering is included  
(D) It costs less

### Q4

According to the policy, can the meeting time potentially be changed without a fee?

(A) Yes, because another room is available the same day  
(B) No, because fewer than 48 hours remain  
(C) No, because catering was ordered  
(D) Yes, but only after 1 P.M.

### Q5

Why does Anna want to cancel catering?

(A) Attendance decreased  
(B) The restaurant is unavailable  
(C) A morning meeting would end before lunch  
(D) The catering price increased

### Q6

Which request is most likely to cause a problem?

(A) Moving the session to Friday morning  
(B) Using Room 3  
(C) Canceling the catering order  
(D) Changing the meeting time

### Q7

Why?

(A) The room is unavailable  
(B) Catering normally requires 72 hours' notice  
(C) Meetings cannot be moved  
(D) Anna did not pay

### 答案

**1C / 2B / 3B / 4A / 5C / 6C / 7B**

---

sections.title: ⑬ Reading 解析
sections.markdown:
這題故意讓：

> **48 hours**

非常顯眼。

Anna：

> reservation = 36 hours away

如果只套取消規則：

> 36 < 48 → fee

很容易認為：

> 改時間也收費。

但是政策另外寫：

> Customers may **change the reservation time without a fee** provided that another room is available on the same day.

Anna 已確認：

> Room 3 Friday morning available.

所以：

> **改時間可以。**

真正問題反而是：

> catering

政策：

> change/cancel catering ≥72 hours

Anna：

> only 36 hours

所以 Catering 才是風險。

這是典型：

> **不要把一條規則套到所有事情。**

---

Q2：

documents 被 submit：

sections.title: ⑳ 第五週難度判定
sections.markdown:
用今天第一次 **15 題小考**的結果判斷：

**14～15 / 15**

→ 正式進入 **900+ 高密度模式**。開始增加 Triple Passage、Part 3/4 高密度同義轉換與 Part 5 速度要求。

**12～13 / 15**

→ 已接近金色證書區間需要的能力；第五週採 **900 題型＋弱點回收**。

**9～11 / 15**

→ 不降低目標，但第五週前兩天維持目前資訊密度，加強錯誤類型。

**≤8 / 15**

→ 暫時不增加文章數量，先做第四週核心修復。

如果主要錯：

> Q1～Q7 → **Grammar**

> Q8～Q10 → **Listening / I / T**

> Q11～Q14 → **Reading / T / E / U**

而 Q15 如果錯，代表目前最需要改變的不是英文知識，而是 **TOEIC 解題策略**。

**Day 28 最重要的觀念：高分題不一定需要更難的英文；真正變難的地方，是同時出現很多「都是真的」資訊，而你必須找到「對這一道題真正適用」的那一條。**

明天 Day 29 將進入第五週，開始 **Part 3/4 900+ 同義轉換、Triple Passage 入門，以及 Part 5 高速辨識訓練**。
